summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I found before touching anything:** I did a read-only audit of the full path (`WatchlistPage.tsx` → `/api/watchlist` → `modules/watchlist` → SQLite). The wiring actually looks correct end-to-end: - No localStorage/anonymous fallback exists anywhere in the watchlist client code (only theme uses localStorage). - Every watchlist handler scopes strictly by `user_id`, which is `NOT NULL` with no default/anonymous path. - The watchlist router has its own auth middleware that hard-401s on missing/invalid session — it can't silent
